newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks up on light month-end buying.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks up on light month-end buying.

text.p: Mexican stocks reversed earlier losses to stand slightly ahead in late trade on Friday due to light month-end buying, traders said.
"Dealing is very slow, although it has been firm enough to withstand some profit-taking. Buying is scant and mostly by locals," a floor trader said.
The leading IPC share index .MXX was up 7.30 points, or 0.19 percent, at 3,943.41.
One single cross trade accounted for 30.3 million shares out of unremarkable total volume .TV.MX of 84.5 million shares traded.
